summary: Give the strict kit-play gate a critical-story set, an a11y on/off switch and a wall-time budget guard, record core-minutes, and require every a11y-on case to carry a passed axe report.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No application or API change. CI runs the gate with its defaults (every story, a11y on, no budget), now also requiring one passed a11y report per case; a new kit-input-gated lane proves the options against a fixture build.
